title: Verify: Hover, click, visibility and keyboard unit tests
summary: Prove interactive behavior with a fake render context and mocked Phaser.
description: Fake DisplayHandle captures registered callbacks so tests can fire pointer events.
acceptance_criteria: Hover, pointerout, pointerdown, bounds and action-less objects are asserted on SceneObject
Context action filtering, focus wrapping and bus events for pointer and ENTER are asserted

steps.action: Assert getContextActions drops an action with conditions [{flag:'k'}] when flag unset and keeps it when set; assert nextFocus(['a','b','c'],'c',1)==='a', nextFocus(['a','b','c'],'a',-1)==='c', nextFocus([],null,1)===null.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/interaction.test.ts

steps.action: With a fake RenderContext whose handles store on() callbacks, build a SceneObject with one action and bounds; invoke the pointerover callback and assert setTint called, label visible, onHover('bed'); pointerout clears tint and calls onHover(null); pointerdown calls onClick('bed') once; assert setInteractive received the bounds and an action-less object never calls setInteractive.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sceneObject.test.ts

steps.action: Mock phaser; create WorldScene, subscribe to phaserToReact objectClick and objectHover, trigger the captured pointer callbacks and assert payloads {id}; trigger the captured ENTER key callback after focusNext and assert objectClick fired for the focused id.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/worldSceneEvents.test.ts
